subject: computer-science
title: Scratch: First Sprites & Scripts
welcome_lead: Drag-and-drop blocks let you build real programs in minutes.
meta_desc: KS3 Scratch: sprites, stage, scripts and motion blocks.
final_note: Block programming hides typing mistakes so ideas come first.

concepts.def: A character or object in Scratch.
A stack of blocks that controls a sprite.
A puzzle piece that gives one instruction.

walkthroughs.body_html: Click the cat sprite. Drag a when flag clicked event, then a say Hello block. Click the green flag and watch it talk.
Motion blocks move sprites. Move 10 steps shifts position. Turn 15 degrees rotates. Combine with a forever loop for animation.
Switch costumes to animate. Two costumes plus a wait of 0.2 seconds gives a simple walking effect.
